units.source_text: 我只是留下一个五角钱的银币，她竟如此惊愕，感动得热泪都快要夺眶而出。

en.t: I had only left behind a fifty-cent silver coin, yet she was so astonished and moved that tears seemed about to spill from her eyes.

units.source_text: 而我只想尽快赶上舞女。

en.t: But all I wanted was to catch up with the dancing girl as quickly as possible.

units.source_text: 老太婆步履蹒跚，反而难为我了。

en.t: The old woman walked with unsteady steps, and that only made things difficult for me.

units.source_text: 我们终于来到了山岭的隧道口。

en.t: At last we reached the entrance to the tunnel in the mountain ridge.
